(actor clock_domain_event_crossing
  (clock-domains
    (domain source (clock bus_clk) (reset bus_rst_n) :default)
    (domain core (clock core_clk) (reset core_rst_n)))
  (crossings
    (event byte_ready
      (from source byte_ready_req)
      (to core byte_ready_pulse)
      (ready byte_ready_ready)))
  (interface
    (input bus_start (domain source))
    (output core_seen (domain core)))
  (transaction bus_capture
    (domain source)
    (on bus_start)
    (await byte_ready_ready)
    (complete byte_ready_req))
  (transaction core_consume
    (domain core)
    (on byte_ready_pulse)
    (complete core_seen)))

(actor clock_domain_event_crossing
  (clock-domains
    (domain source (clock bus_clk) (reset bus_rst_n) :default)
    (domain core (clock core_clk) (reset core_rst_n)))
  (crossings
    (activation worker (from source) (to core))
    (event byte_ready

      (to core byte_ready_pulse)

  (interface

  (transaction bus_capture

    (await byte_ready_ready)
    (do worker)
    (complete byte_ready_req))
  (transaction worker (domain core) (complete worker_observed))
  (transaction core_consume
    (domain core)
    (on byte_ready_pulse)
    (complete core_seen)))
